item.title: Matthews shakes slump, Maple Leafs shake Senators 7-5
item.description: TORONTO — Captain Auston Matthews shook off a slump with a goal and two assists, and Matthew Knies scored twice to lead the Toronto Maple Leafs to a sloppy 7-5 win against the Ottawa Senators on Saturday.

item.title: Boldy scores in OT as Wild rally to beat Jets 4-3
item.description: WINNIPEG — Matt Boldy scored two goals, including the winner just 39 seconds into overtime, to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 4-3 come-from-behind victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday night.

item.title: NHL roundup: Samuelsson, Sabres make it eight in a row with 4-1 win over Bruins
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (AP) — Mattias Samuelsson had a goal and two assists as the Buffalo Sabres beat the Boston Bruins 4-1 on Saturday night for their eighth straight victory.

item.title: 'The past gives comfort': Finding refuge on analog islands amid deepening digital seas
item.description: As technology distracts, polarizes and automates, people are still finding refuge on analog islands in the digital sea.

item.title: Foods with healthy-sounding buzzwords could be hiding added sugar in plain sight
item.description: Many consumers feel pride in avoiding the glazed pastries in the supermarket and instead opting for “all natural” granola that comes packed with extra protein.

item.title: Vancouver product Macklin Celebrini nets two points, Sharks double up Canucks 6-3
item.description: VANCOUVER — Vancouver product Macklin Celebrini had a goal and an assist, powering the visiting San Jose Sharks to a 6-3 victory over the Canucks on Saturday.

item.title: Flames remain hot at home, burn Oilers 3-2
item.description: CALGARY — Blake Coleman's 11th goal of the season, tying him for the team lead, was the game winner on Saturday as the Calgary Flames edged the visiting Edmonton Oilers 3-2.

item.title: Polls open for Myanmar's first election since military seized power
item.description: YANGON, Myanmar (AP) — Voters went to the polls Sunday for the initial phase of Myanmar ’s first general election in five years, held under the supervision of its military government while a civil war rages throughout much of the country.
